div.head: IV Eg 2
div.ab: Woruldgerihta ic wille þæt standen on ælcum leodscipe swa gode swa hy mon betste aredian mæge, Gode to gecwemnysse ⁊ me to fullum cynescipe ⁊ earmum ⁊ eadegum to ðearfe ⁊ to friðe.
Woruldgerihta ic wille þæt standen on ælcum leodscype swa gode swa hi mon betste aredian mæge, Gode to gecwemnysse ⁊ me to fullum cynescype ⁊ earmum ⁊ eadegum to ðearfe ⁊ to friðe.

In nomine sancte et indiuidue Trinitatis moderantis uniuersum orbem præcipio statuere in unaquaque regione terrarum mundane iustitię legem, quantocumque quis inuestigando ordinare ualuerit meliorem, ad immense maiestatis gloriam et honorem diuitibusque ad gaudium et pacem et pauperibus ad plenam consolationem.
Woruldgerihta ic wille þæt standen on ælcum leodscype swa gode swa hi mon betste aredian mæge, Gode to gecwemnysse ⁊ me to fullum cynescype ⁊ earmum ⁊ eadegum to ðearfe ⁊ to friðe.

My will is that the rights of the laity be maintained in every province at the best standard which can be devised, in accordance with what will be acceptable to God, and will preserve my royal dignity unimpaired, and tend to the advantage and security of rich and poor.

It is my will that secular rights be in force in every province, as good as they can best be devised, to the satisfaction of God, and for my full royal dignity and for the benefit and security of poor and rich;

✠ Weltliche Rechte will ich, dass in jeder Völkerschaft so gute bestehen, wie man sie als beste ausfindig machen kann, Gott zum Wohlgefallen und mir zur vollen Königswürde und Armen und Reichen zum Nutzen und zur Sicherheit.
✠ I will that secular rights stand in every nation as good as they can best be devised, to the pleasure of God and to my full royal dignity, and to the benefit and security of poor and rich.
